notes.title: Update coming soon
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone,

Marble Mountain is currently 50% off, and we just wanted to share with everyone why this is a great time to pick it up!

Coming soon will be our first major update to the game. We have a variety of things planned including:
[list]
[*] New giant level 'The Gauntlet'
[*] Performance Improvements
[*] More localisation
[*] A new VR options section
[/list]

Talking a bit more about the VR options improvement, we have really taken on board and appreciate the feedback from a number of players that they are having difficulties with the current camera system. In the coming update, there will be a number of options players can use such as slow down camera transitions, implement vignetting, and static cameras.

Happy rolling ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Hotfix live
notes.notes:
Number of minor fixes and updates

[list]
[*]Made 'Great Balls of Fire' achievement easier to achieve
[*]A marble unlock was not working for some beta users
[*]Changed a player setting to ensure program starts on all computers
[*]Fixed bug where some controllers would consistently pull left
[/list]
